summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K for the month of June 2026, reporting poll results of its annual general meeting held on June 26, 2026. The filing confirms that all proposed ordinary resolutions were duly passed by shareholders. It provides details on voting procedures, share count, and class structures but does not disclose any transaction, corporate action, or special situation. This is a routine disclosure of annual meeting results, not a special situation.
